# name|color|description   (the Labels workflow creates or updates these labels on main)
new-project|0e8a16|A new project (the form "New project" of the hub)
needs-human|d93f0b|Waits for a person: standards/HUMAN.md
decision|fbca04|A card: a decision with a recommendation
step|c5def5|A card: a step that only the owner can do
proposal|5319e7|A card: a new direction, a resource, an integration or a tool
feedback|a2eeef|Feedback from a person who uses a product
P0|b60205|Do next
P1|d93f0b|High priority
P2|fbca04|Normal priority
P3|c5def5|Later
size:S|e6f4ea|One short PR
size:M|bfe5c8|One PR, up to about 400 lines
size:L|7fc98f|Too large: the agent splits it first
bug|d73a4a|Something works wrong
feature|a2eeef|New function
tooling|5319e7|Tests and tools for the agent
design|f9d0c4|The look of a page or of a product
docs|0075ca|Documentation
cleanup|cfd3d7|Code cleanup without new function
blocked|000000|Waits for another ticket
in-progress|0e8a16|The agent works on it now
epic|3e4b9e|Parent ticket with sub-issues
agent-status|1d76db|The dashboard of the agent
paused|b60205|On the status issue: the agent stops
muted|d4c5f9|Muted by the owner: the agents skip it and the dashboard hides it
after-release|d4c5f9|Held until the next release (tag v*): agents skip it, the After release workflow removes it
rank|d4c5f9|After a release: waits until a deep run ranks the released tickets (P1 to P3)
release|0e8a16|The epic "Release vX.Y.Z" (its milestone holds the scope): the Release workflow tags it
hold|fbca04|On a PR: the Automerge workflow does not merge it
automerge|0e8a16|On a PR: the Automerge workflow merges it when CI is green, on any branch
conflict|b60205|On a PR: the Automerge workflow could not merge it
#rename lane:deep|lane:fable
lane:fable|5319e7|A hard ticket for a Fable run (ticket skill, "Model lanes")
lane:haiku|c2e0c6|A clear, templated ticket for a Haiku run (ticket skill, "Model lanes")
lane:sonnet|bfd4f2|A clear ticket with little to decide, for a Sonnet run (ticket skill, "Model lanes")
process|5319e7|Improves the agent system itself: the loop, the tools, the setup
close|0e8a16|The Close workflow closes this issue as completed (#1740)
